skill.name: Deterrence
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to {0} consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Parry Stance</color></size>
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>,
during which STA is consumed continuously over time and DMG taken is reduced by {1}%. Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to end the <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> and deliver the <color=Highlight>Riposte Strike</color>, dealing <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=instance P=instances SapTag=2} of <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. If <color=Highlight>Riposte Strike</color> is unleashed right when the target’s attack hits, Stagnate the target and cast <color=Highlight>Riposte Strike: Crumble</color>. During <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>, consume STA and dash to <color=Highlight>flash</color> towards the directional input, during which successful Dodge can be triggered when hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack in the air, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {3}</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skill.name: Myriad Omens’ Mandate
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Overshock</color></size>
At max <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing}, clear all <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> to grant Resonators in the team {0}% ATK Bonus for {1}s.
When Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by holding down, enter <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Apex Resonance</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> is unlocked, which consumes {2}% <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color>: While on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to chain into Rover: Havoc’s and Rover: Spectro’s skills. Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to chain into Rover: Aero’s skill and leap into the air. While in the air, the skill can chain into Rover: Havoc and Rover: Aero. The DMG dealt through <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> corresponds to the corresponding Attribute of the chained skills. <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> triggers <color=Highlight>Thunder Bane</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Electric Surge</color></size>
Normal Attacks and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> restores <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> on hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Rage</color></size>
Upon entering <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>, <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color> is restored. <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> restores <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color> on hit.
<size=10></size>

81001310.bg_description: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.

81011310.bg_description: Rover's uniform from a past life at Startorch Academy. The black-and-white motif, accented with gold stripes, weaves past and future together, ensuring that what has happened is remembered and what is yet to come feels within reach.
